name: ff-3mf-converter
description: Self-hosted 3MF project converter for FlashForge printers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ff3mf/shared && npm run build -w @ff3mf/profiles && npm run build -w @ff3mf/core && npm run build -w @ff3mf/api && npm run build -w @ff3mf/cli && npm run build -w @ff3mf/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ff3mf/shared && npm run build -w @ff3mf/profiles && npm run build -w @ff3mf/core
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ff3mf/api && concurrently -k -n api,web "node apps/api/dist/server.js" "npm run dev -w @ff3mf/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/profiles && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/core && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/api && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/cli && npm run typecheck -w @ff3mf/web
